coverage.interpretation: Eight registered boundary-kernel families, three new full lengths each. Shared generator mechanisms are exercised across their different local lengths and factors; staged controls retain their registered default. This does not establish gains for unsupported or unmeasured kernel families.
coverage.attribution: Only legal CC map entries are added. Existing pair selection, generators, buffer layout and both exchange implementations are unchanged. Official/stable comparisons include plan-choice differences.
coverage.timing: Default paths only; one process per size/type/version; batch 1; three warmups, 50 raw event samples; median ratios only; no outlier deletion.
